title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Casino Rama, Rama | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Casino Rama in Rama, Ontario, Canada, on 27 May 2022.

It was the first show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022, and the first of two consecutive nights in Rama.

Starr had previously performed at the Casino Rama on 26 July 2001, 24 and 25 July 2003, 14 and 15 June 2006, 20 June 2008, 25 June 2010, and 6 June 2014.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
